facts: About 12,000 people (2025), about 40% of the region's population
On the main island, 6 m above sea level
worth_knowing: Founded on 21 February 1861 and named after the Russian empress Maria Alexandrovna, the name meaning "Marie's Port". The city is Swedish-speaking.
